data.one_liner: Dynamically change and reset app launcher icons at runtime on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A cross-platform Flutter plugin and CLI tool that lets you switch app launcher icons at runtime on Android and iOS. It automatically resizes source images into required multi-density assets and injects necessary native configurations into AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist.
use_when: You want to allow users to pick a custom app launcher icon from within your app settings.
You want an automated CLI tool to handle native asset resizing and configuration for app icons.
avoid_when: You only need a single static app icon (use flutter_launcher_icons instead).
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Automates native boilerplate generation for both Android and iOS.
Provides a strongly-typed generated definitions file and reactive ValueNotifier.
Supports zero-manual-setup workflows via a CLI generator.
weaknesses: Requires native platform support (Android 7.0+ and iOS 15.0+).
Requires running a CLI generation step for asset processing and manifest injections.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding a chameleon_icons block to pubspec.yaml and running the CLI generator dart run chameleon_icons:generate.

alternatives.name: flutter_launcher_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you only need to generate static compile-time app launcher icons rather than switching them dynamically at runtime.
